aggregation.group_scope: Coffee-held with shared graders/conditions/sources; no new coffee confirmation or participant independence
aggregation.outcomes: gap delta < -1e-12 improvement, >1e-12 regression, otherwise tie; computational tolerance, not practical/statistical significance
aggregation.paired: C01-C00 per exact record then coffee mean; seeded paired coffee bootstrap2000 draws seed20260906; 2.5/97.5 percentiles; descriptive only, repeatedly viewed development
aggregation.point: within-coffee mean then equal coffee means; same full cohort all layers; empty/missing counts explicit
aggregation.separate_k: L/M k5 vs U/P k8; no pooled cross-budget improvement

cohort: All archived C00/C01 records paired by unique record_id/group_id/full_T/hidden_T; no reselection, refit, resplit or exclusion for empty T
endpoint: Q0-Q4 PRELIMINARY_RESULT; no FINAL_COMPARISON; P is proposed, not actually exposed to a human
extraction: Frozen outer expert via train_conditioning_r4.model_bundle then flavor_conditioning_r4.finalize_result(deepcopy(original state)); original state/model/ranking/questions/answers/T hashes unchanged; returned updated state retained separately

gain_diagnostics.details: At most8 private cases: deterministic round-robin SHA(record_id) within gain-retained, legacy-gain-lost, pool-gain-without-main, regression, tie; all cases audited before selection
gain_diagnostics.directions: existing PARENTS projection of fine T versus returned broad/fine directions; derived semantic proxy only
gain_diagnostics.faithfulness: canonical explicitly selected fine IDs: generated/main/U/P counts and denominators; report demand exceeding k; no impossible100% mandate
gain_diagnostics.secondary: exact target hits in secondary minus main, never sum matching across layers
gain_diagnostics.transition: Compare original ranking with finalizer updated rank; label exclusion by actual M/U/P boundary and preceding broad/fine counts, not causal removal experiments.
gain_diagnostics.unreturned_L: Report outside U and P separately; exact hits and marginal loss of legacy maximum matching when outside IDs withheld without replacement. Also report one deterministic optimal matching witness; tie-equivalent witnesses are not uniquely causal.

helper.source: User-supplied r8_output_alignment_helper.py attachment; integration example, not authority to modify runtime

metrics.duplicates: flag contract violation; later occurrence cannot score or compress positions
metrics.hidden: Same archived fixed hidden_T, separate secondary analysis; no exclusion recomputed from new output
metrics.limits: M<=5 secondary<=3 U<=8; P eligible iff unique3-8 and actual flag; malformed IDs/version conflicts block affected evaluation until audited; no silent truncation
metrics.missing: MISSING_ARTIFACT is null, distinct from reproducible runtime failure with empty outputs. Empty T null in all layers; retain all records and coverage denominators. Missing exposure remains null, even if main exists.
metrics.ndcg: linear exact target-weight relevance / log2(actual_position+1); full sorted positive T weights IDCG at declared k; broad and later duplicate slots keep position with zero credit
metrics.raw_gap: 1 - original one-to-one parent maximum_matching / distinct positive full-T count; exact1 registered fine shared-parent0.25. Target magnitudes only affect NDCG, consistent with historical metric.
metrics.recall: distinct exact fine hits / full positive T count
metrics.scope: FINE_REFERENCE_ON_RETURNED_OUTPUT; not total sensory value or calibrated psychological distance
metrics.unavailable_targets: All fixed T and OOV/ungenerated targets retained; no invented predictions, no denominator shrink
